name: Xana
body:
Xana
CR 5

This female humanoid has pale skin but raven-dark hair. Her eyes are luminous pools of blue and flowing robes drape her slender form.

XP 1,600
N (NG for aloja)
Medium fey (aquatic, shapechanger)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 68 (8d6+40)
Fort +7, Ref +11, Will +9; SR 16

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee dagger +9 (1d4+2/19–20)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks alluring voice (DC 19)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 11th, concentration +16)

Constant—speak with animals
At will—hydraulic push, prestidigitation, purify food and drink, water walk
3/day—cure light wounds, detect poison, lesser restoration, remove disease
1/day—charm animal (DC 16), charm person (DC 16), locate creature, locate object, mass cure light wounds (DC 20)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 21, Con 20, Int 16, Wis 16, Cha 21
Base Atk +4; CMB +16; CMD 32
Feats Dodge, Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +16, Climb +13, Diplomacy +16, Fly +12, Knowledge (nature) +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Spellcraft +11, Stealth +16, Swim +13, Use Magic Device +12
Languages Aquan, Common, Sylvan
SQ amphibious, clear sight, shape change (blackbird—use the stats of for a raven, beast shape II), water freedom

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Alluring Voice (Su)

The xana targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 19 Will saving throw. On a failure, the target becomes unable to take any action but to move at its full movement rate toward the xana. On its turn, the target can make a new saving throw; if it fails, it must move in the most direct way possible toward the xana, avoiding obstacles. If it encounters water, it must attempt to swim to the xana. It need not, and cannot, take the run action. Once the target reaches the xana, it remains by her side, and continues to approach her on its turn if she moves away. On a successful save, the effect ends. This is a sonic, mind-affecting, compulsion effect. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that xana’s alluring voice for 24 hours.

Clear Sight (Ex)

A xana’s vision is not affected by mist, smoke, fog, or water. Underwater, a xana’s darkvision has a range of 120 feet.

Water Freedom (Su)

While in a body of water, the xana is affected continuously as the spell, freedom of movement.

ECOLOGY

Environment any water
Organization solitary
Treasure standard (dagger, plus other treasure)

Xanas are water spirits that dwell near natural pools, springs, and lakes. They are said to represent the lifegiving nature of water and can be prideful, living for thousands of years. They are nocturnal, often shapeshifting into the form of blackbirds to explore the surrounding territory unwatched, though their eyes are always keen and bright with intelligence. While xanas can be kind, some are more malicious, stealing from travelers or exchanging treasures for worthless trinkets, and their sultry voice is eerily alluring. They are even known to sneak into homes and exchange fey changelings for the children of mortals, though they can be capricious and may be as likely to bring healing or boons unlooked for in times of trouble.

Some xanas are as benevolent as they are beautiful, bringing prosperity to the lands and waters where they dwell. They may give generous gifts to those they observe doing good for their fellows or finding lost items and bestowing them on travelers through their domains.
